mapper.select: select i.name, i.kind, u.name as unitName, i.price, s.name as supplierName, i.description, i.is_active as active from item i left join unit u on i.unit_id = u.unit_id left join supplier s on i.supplier_id = s.supplier_id where i.item_id = #{itemId}

select i.name as itemName, i.kind, u.unit_id, u.name as unitName, s.supplier_id, s.name as supplierName, i.price from item i join unit u on i.unit_id = u.unit_id join supplier s on i.supplier_id = s.supplier_id where i.item_id = #{itemId} and i.is_active = true
mapper.update: update item set name = #{name}, kind = #{kind}, unit_id = #{unitId}, price = #{price}, supplier_id = #{supplierId}, description = #{description}, is_active = #{isActive} where item_id = #{itemId}
